### P2 - Medium

- **[/tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/codex-baseline-R6M-isolated-2/config.py:1]** Enabling detailed reports breaks default reports for empty batches
  - Profile: python · Checklist: code-quality-checklist.md
  - Triggered by: content signal (extension-only) — .py on config.py and tests/test_report.py
  - `report([])` previously returned `"Items: 0"`. This change makes it call `summarize([], detailed=True)`, where `stats.py:4` evaluates `0 / 0` and raises `ZeroDivisionError`. README.md:9–13 explicitly requires empty batches to succeed in either mode. The existing empty-batch test supplies `detailed=False`, so it misses this regression.
  - Confidence: 100% — re-reading the default resolution and arithmetic confirms the exception for an expressly supported input.
  - Suggested fix: Calculate and include the mean only when the count is positive. Add coverage asserting that both `report([])` and `report([], detailed=True)` return `"Items: 0"`.
